findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: signup, verify_email · Private data: signup, verify_email · Public sink: signup, verify_email.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: signup, verify_email · Private data: signup, verify_email · Public sink: signup, verify_email

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
